title: umbraco-ai-ops consumer config
description: How the engine runs in ONE repo. Lives at the consumer repo's `.claude/ai-ops.yml`. Every loop reads it; `/umbraco-ops-setup` writes it (detecting what it can, asking the rest). Where a field is omitted, the engine auto-detects or uses the documented default — so a plain gitflow, same-repo, GitHub-checks repo may need almost nothing.

source.description: owner/name the routine works in and opens PRs on. Auto-detected from `git remote origin`.

inbox.description: owner/name where `ready-for-ai` issues live. Defaults to `source`. Set to a different repo for split issues (e.g. Umbraco.Forms.Issues).

issue_link.description: How PRs reference the issue. Auto: `same-repo-closes` when inbox==source, else `cross-repo-full-url` (full URL; never `#N` across repos).

provider.description: Which CI github-ops reads. Auto: `azure-pipelines` if an azure-pipelines.yml / .azure-pipelines exists, else `github-checks`.

gh_repo.description: azure-pipelines only: the GitHub repo builds are wired to. Defaults to repos.source.

branching.description: The repo's branch/merge/release model. `model` picks built-in behaviour; `release_skill` hands anything bespoke to a skill the applied repo owns.

model.description: gitflow = dev+main; main-only = main; versioned-gitflow = vN/dev+vN/main per major (Forms, Automate); custom = fully defined by release_skill. Auto-detected from `git branch -a`.

base.description: Integration branch PRs target. Auto: `dev`, or the highest `vN/dev` for versioned-gitflow. NOTE: routines clone the default branch — keep the canonical consumer skill there.

merge_strategy.description: How merge-flow merges into base. Default `squash`.

branch_naming.description: Optional convention hint, e.g. `v{major}/{type}/{desc}` (Forms enforces this via a git hook).

release_skill.description: Applied-repo skill that OWNS cutting/tagging/version-bump/back-merge (e.g. `release-management`). When set, auto-release-loop orchestrates and defers the mechanics to it instead of the engine's release-flow default. REQUIRED when model=custom.

inbox.description: owner/name where proto-learning issues are filed.

routing.description: Free-form note on where triage routes learnings (shared-skills / product-repo / loop-self).

playbook.description: The consumer skill that carries the per-issue build playbook and invokes issue-loop-core. Default `issue-loop` (i.e. `.claude/skills/issue-loop/`).
